fact: On 9 October 2023 the Ministry of Interior signed with the Hyundai-Samsung consortium the contract for SIGESP-MINT, a four-year project financed by a Korea Exim credit agreement of 25 May 2021 (US$80.8 million, Mozambique contributing US$7.9 million), building operations rooms in Maputo, Matola, Boane, Marracuene and Nampula districts and an AFIS for SERNIC.
title: Assinado contrato de adjudicação do projecto SIGESP-MINT
